ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In $\triangle ABC$, points D and E are located on sides AB and AC respectively, such that $DE\parallel BC$ and $AD: BD = 3: 2$. What is the ratio of the area of $\triangle ADE$ to that of quadrilateral $BCED$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\because \frac{AD}{BD}=\frac{3}{2}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{AD}{AB}=\frac{3}{5}$,\\
$\because DE \parallel BC$,\\
$\therefore \triangle ADE \sim \triangle ABC$,\\
$\therefore \frac{S_{\triangle ADE}}{S_{\triangle ABC}}=\left(\frac{AD}{AB}\right)^2=\left(\frac{3}{5}\right)^2=\frac{9}{25}$,\\
$\therefore \frac{S_{\triangle ADE}}{S_{\text{quadrilateral} BCED}}=\boxed{\frac{9}{16}}$.
